description: Paste any text, click words to black them out, and the surviving words become your poem.

faqs.a: Click a word to black it out; click again to bring it back. Blacked-out words are hidden from the poem.
faqs.q: How do I black out words?

faqs.a: The poem keeps the original word order of every word you left visible.
faqs.q: What order do poem words keep?

faqs.a: Press Reset to restore all blacked-out words, or load fresh source text any time.

howto: Press Load text, then click words to black them out.
Copy poem to grab the surviving words.
title: Blackout Poetry Maker
